other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation feature leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Group-level aggregations and statistics are computed on the entire training dataset before it is split into cross-validation folds. This leaks feature distribution information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold validation scores slightly optimistic.

summary: The agent provided an exceptionally high-quality and robust solution with no major failure modes. They correctly formulated the problem, prevented target leakage by dropping other drug columns, implemented extensive domain-specific feature engineering, and built a strong optimized ensemble of tree-based models and a custom Tabular ResNet. The only minor flaw is a slight feature leakage across cross-validation folds due to computing group aggregations on the full training set before the CV split.
